title: AttributedString: Styling Runs
hints: Set `attributed[range].inlinePresentationIntent = .stronglyEmphasized`; continue searching after the range.
jsBridge: `AttributedString` stores text plus attribute **runs** (ranges with styles). The web does this with nested `<span>`s. `Text` renders it natively, so highlighting search matches is just setting attributes on ranges.

compass.q: Highlighting search terms on the web means splitting the string into spans. How does `AttributedString` avoid rebuilding the view tree?
